name: Modern Rabbit 52
author: SouravBandyopadhyay
description: Gradient dark rounded orange text input that changes colour on hover.
howItWorks:
On hover, background changes from linear-gradient(
    330.28deg,
    #ff6e1d 100%,
    #ff6e1d 100%,
    #ff6e1d 100%
  ) to linear-gradient(
    330.28deg,
    #2cfff2 0%,
    #1e78ff 30.73%,
    #ff54a6 55.73%,
    #ff6e1d 79.17%,
    #ff3e3e 100%
  ). On focus, background changes from linear-gradient(
    330.28deg,
    #ff6e1d 100%,
    #ff6e1d 100%,
    #ff6e1d 100%
  ) to linear-gradient(
    330.28deg,
    #2cfff2 0%,
    #1e78ff 30.73%,
    #ff54a6 55.73%,
    #ff6e1d 79.17%,
    #ff3e3e 100%
  ).
